```{r}
health_data <- read.csv("/Users/evelynhuang/Desktop/STA497/dirty_v3_path.csv", header = TRUE)

health_data <- na.omit(health_data)

health_data <- health_data %>% select(-c(random_notes, noise_col))

age_q <- quantile(health_data$Age, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)
bmi_q <- quantile(health_data$BMI, probs = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE, type = 7)

health_data$age_bin <- ifelse(health_data$Age <= age_q, "Age_Low", "Age_High")
health_data$bmi_bin <- ifelse(health_data$BMI <= bmi_q, "BMI_Low", "BMI_High")

health_data$region_2x2 <- paste(health_data$age_bin, health_data$bmi_bin, sep = "__")

health_data$region_2x2 <- factor(
  health_data$region_2x2,
  levels = c(
    "Age_Low__BMI_Low",
    "Age_Low__BMI_High",
    "Age_High__BMI_Low",
    "Age_High__BMI_High"
  )
)

table(health_data$region_2x2, useNA = "ifany")
age_q; bmi_q
```


```{r}
## 1) select variables (exclude Age and BMI)
X <- subset(health_data, select = -c(Age, BMI))

## keep only numeric columns (PCA needs numeric)
X_num <- X[, sapply(X, is.numeric), drop = FALSE]

## 2) standardize (z-score)
X_scaled <- scale(X_num, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

## 3) PCA
pca_fit <- prcomp(X_scaled, center = FALSE, scale. = FALSE)

## 4) Scree plot (base R)
eig <- pca_fit$sdev^2
pve <- eig / sum(eig)

plot(
  pve,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Principal Component",
  ylab = "Proportion of Variance Explained",
  main = "Scree Plot (PCA on standardized variables, excluding Age & BMI)"
)

## optional: cumulative PVE line
lines(cumsum(pve), type = "b")
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("PVE", "Cumulative PVE"),
  lty = 1,
  pch = 1,
  bty = "n"
)

```

# hta function

```{r}
compute_ht <- function(df, region_col = "region_2x2", trait_col = "trait") {

  ok <- !is.na(df[[region_col]]) & !is.na(df[[trait_col]])
  d <- df[ok, , drop = FALSE]

  # --- FORCE atomic vectors (prevents list-column bugs) ---
  to_atomic_chr <- function(x) {
    if (is.list(x)) return(vapply(x, function(z) as.character(z)[1], character(1)))
    as.character(x)
  }
  d[[region_col]] <- factor(to_atomic_chr(d[[region_col]]))
  d[[trait_col]]  <- factor(to_atomic_chr(d[[trait_col]]))
  # --------------------------------------------------------

  trait_levels <- levels(d[[trait_col]])
  if (is.null(trait_levels) || anyNA(trait_levels)) {
    trait_levels <- sort(unique(d[[trait_col]]))
  }
  C <- length(trait_levels)
  if (C <= 1) stop("Need >= 2 trait categories to compute HTI/HTA.")

  hti_region <- function(x) {
    tab <- table(factor(x, levels = trait_levels))
    p <- as.numeric(tab) / sum(tab)
    p <- p[p > 0]
    -sum(p * log(p)) / log(C)
  }

  regions <- levels(d[[region_col]])
  if (is.null(regions) || anyNA(regions)) regions <- sort(unique(d[[region_col]]))

  n_by_region <- sapply(regions, function(r) sum(d[[region_col]] == r))
  local_hti   <- sapply(regions, function(r) hti_region(d[[trait_col]][d[[region_col]] == r]))
  weights     <- n_by_region / sum(n_by_region)
  HTA         <- sum(weights * local_hti)

  list(HTA = HTA, local_hti = local_hti, n_by_region = n_by_region, weights = weights)
}
```


```{r}
# 1) run one kmeans + HTA
run_kmeans_ht <- function(df, scores, pcs_use, k,
                          region_col = "region_2x2",
                          nstart = 100, max_iter = 1000, seed = 1) {
  stopifnot(all(pcs_use %in% colnames(scores)))
  stopifnot(nrow(df) == nrow(scores))
  stopifnot(region_col %in% names(df))

  set.seed(seed)
  km <- kmeans(
    x = scores[, pcs_use, drop = FALSE],
    centers = k,
    nstart = nstart,
    iter.max = max_iter
  )

  df2 <- df
  df2$trait_cluster <- factor(paste0("Cluster_", km$cluster))

  # compute HTA (if it errors, return NA + message)
  res <- tryCatch(
    compute_ht(df2, region_col = region_col, trait_col = "trait_cluster"),
    error = function(e) list(HTA = NA_real_, local_hti = NA, .err = e$message)
  )

  list(
    HTA = res$HTA,
    local_hti = res$local_hti,
    iter = km$iter,
    tot_withinss = km$tot.withinss,
    size = km$size,
    err_msg = res$.err
  )
}

# 2) sweep k for a fixed PC set
sweep_k_ht <- function(df, scores, pcs_use, k_values,
                       region_col = "region_2x2",
                       nstart = 100, max_iter = 1000, seed = 1) {
  out <- lapply(k_values, function(k) {
    r <- run_kmeans_ht(
      df = df, scores = scores, pcs_use = pcs_use, k = k,
      region_col = region_col, nstart = nstart, max_iter = max_iter, seed = seed
    )

    data.frame(
      pcs = paste(pcs_use, collapse = ","),
      d = length(pcs_use),
      k = k,
      HTA = r$HTA,
      err_msg = ifelse(is.null(r$err_msg), NA_character_, r$err_msg),
      iter = r$iter,
      tot_withinss = r$tot_withinss,
      size_min = min(r$size),
      size_max = max(r$size)
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

# 3) sweep across PC sets + k
sweep_pcsets_k_ht <- function(df, scores, pc_sets, k_values,
                              region_col = "region_2x2",
                              nstart = 100, max_iter = 1000, seed = 1) {
  all_res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(pc_sets), function(set_name) {
    pcs_use <- pc_sets[[set_name]]
    tmp <- sweep_k_ht(
      df = df, scores = scores, pcs_use = pcs_use, k_values = k_values,
      region_col = region_col, nstart = nstart, max_iter = max_iter, seed = seed
    )
    tmp$pc_set <- set_name
    tmp
  }))
  all_res <- all_res[, c("pc_set", setdiff(names(all_res), "pc_set"))]
  all_res[order(all_res$pc_set, all_res$k), , drop = FALSE]
}
```


# heterogeneous dataset clustering
```{r}
scores <- as.data.frame(pca_fit$x)

# quick sanity checks
stopifnot(nrow(health_data) == nrow(scores))
stopifnot("region_2x2" %in% names(health_data))

pc_sets <- list(
  PC4 = paste0("PC", 1:4),
  PC6 = paste0("PC", 1:6),
  PC8 = paste0("PC", 1:8)
)

k_values <- 2:15   # or 6:12, etc.

het_results <- sweep_pcsets_k_ht(
  df = health_data,
  scores = scores,
  pc_sets = pc_sets,
  k_values = k_values,
  region_col = "region_2x2",
  nstart = 100,
  max_iter = 1000,
  seed = 1
)

print(het_results)
```


```{r}
# basic plot: HTA vs k, one line per pc_set
ggplot(het_results, aes(x = k, y = HTA, group = pc_set)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ pc_set, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "k (number of clusters)", y = "HTA") +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(het_results, aes(x = k, y = HTA, color = pc_set, group = pc_set)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(x = "k (number of clusters)", y = "HTA", color = "PC set") +
  theme_bw()
```

## check why homogenoeus dataset has a high HTA
```{r}
# pick the same settings you used for the plot
pcs_use <- paste0("PC", 1:4)
k <- 3

scores_homo <- as.data.frame(pca_fit_homo$x)
stopifnot(nrow(health_homo) == nrow(scores_homo))

set.seed(1)
km <- kmeans(
  x = scores_homo[, pcs_use, drop = FALSE],
  centers = k,
  nstart = 100,
  iter.max = 1000,
  algorithm = "Lloyd"
)

df2 <- health_homo
df2$trait_cluster <- factor(paste0("Cluster_", km$cluster))
```


```{r}
tab <- with(df2, table(region_2x2, trait_cluster))
prop <- prop.table(tab, margin = 1)   # within-region proportions

# optional: look at a few regions
prop[1:min(5, nrow(prop)), 1:min(10, ncol(prop))]

# summarize how uniform the mix is per region
apply(prop, 1, function(p) {
  p <- p[p > 0]
  c(entropy = -sum(p * log(p)) / log(length(levels(df2$trait_cluster))),
    max_p = max(p),
    min_p = min(p))
})
```

```{r}
sizes <- km$size
sizes
c(min = min(sizes), max = max(sizes), ratio = max(sizes)/min(sizes), sd = sd(sizes))
```

```{r}
mean(silhouette(km$cluster, dist(Z))[,3])
```

```{r}
# make sure it's treated as a label
df2$trait_combo <- as.character(df2$trait_cluster)

# region x trait table
tab  <- with(df2, table(region_2x2, trait_combo))
prop <- prop.table(tab, 1)

# for each region: max proportion and entropy
max_prop <- apply(prop, 1, max)
entropy  <- apply(prop, 1, function(p) {
  p <- p[p > 0]
  -sum(p * log(p))
})

data.frame(region = rownames(prop), max_prop = max_prop, entropy = entropy)

# optional: see the full per-region proportions
round(prop, 3)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
B <- 500

# observed (real regions)
obs <- compute_ht(
  df = df2,
  region_col = "region_2x2",
  trait_col  = "trait_cluster"
)
hta_obs <- obs$HTA

# null: permute region labels (keeps region sizes identical)
hta_null <- replicate(B, {
  df_tmp <- df2
  df_tmp$region_perm <- sample(df_tmp$region_2x2)
  compute_ht(
    df = df_tmp,
    region_col = "region_perm",
    trait_col  = "trait_cluster"
  )$HTA
})

mean_null <- mean(hta_null)
sd_null   <- sd(hta_null)
z         <- (hta_obs - mean_null) / sd_null
p_right   <- mean(hta_null >= hta_obs)                 # one-sided (high HTA)
p_two     <- 2 * min(mean(hta_null >= hta_obs), mean(hta_null <= hta_obs))

list(
  hta_obs   = hta_obs,
  mean_null = mean_null,
  sd_null   = sd_null,
  z         = z,
  p_right   = p_right,
  p_two     = p_two
)
```
